title: Effect of Coadministration of Sotorasib on the Pharmacokinetics of Rosuvastatin in Healthy Participants

sections.abstract:
A study to determine the effect of sotorasib on the pharmacokinetics (PK) of rosuvastatin, and to assess the PK of rosuvastatin when administered alone, in healthy participants.

Posted outcomes: Maximum Observed Plasma Concentration (Cmax) of Rosuvastatin. timeframe=Predose (Hour 0), 0.5, 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 8, 10, 12, 24, 36, 48, 72, 96, and 120 . Rosuvastatin=3.80 (±57.80); Sotorasib + Rosuvastatin=6.47 (±136.00)
